caption: The drawing depicts a pair of wooden shutters seen from the outside, rendered in muted tones of brown and beige to indicate the wood grain and knots. The shutters are rectangular and placed side-by-side, each with vertical panels and bordered by a rectangular frame, with visible natural wood patterns including dark knots and wavy grain lines. Above the shutters, there is a horizontal section illustrating the profile of the wood molding in light brown with a wavy line detail. Below the shutter illustration, there is a horizontal strip giving a cross-sectional view of the wood, similarly colored in light and medium browns with visible wood grain. Below this, a black and white scale is drawn, labeled as “6 inches” and “1 ft”. The text “Outside of Shutters” is written in cursive below the main shutter drawing, and the name “Geoffrey Holt” is signed in the lower right corner of the page. The background is an off-white, unadorned page.
title: Original Wooden Shutters from Monastery
